info.description:
How to get Access Token?

How to get eventId, organiserId, sessionId/agendaId?

Note: To help manage the volume of these requests, limits are placed on the number of requests that can be made. These limits help us provide the reliable and scalable API that the developer relies on. We have imposed a limit of 20 requests per second at the organizer level. This is a combined total limit for all APIs. Please reach out to your Customer Success Manager in case of any queries

Changelog:
1. Delist Exhibitor Booth API is added to the Exhibitor folder of the PostMan documentation.
2. Remove Booth Member API is added to the Exhibitor folder of the PostMan documentation.
3. Delete User API is added to the User folder of the PostMan documentation.
4. Delete Session API is added to the Session folder of the PostMan documentation.
5. Moved to a new version 1.2 enabling support for Hybrid and in-person events.
6. Old versions will continue to work as-is.

request.description:
Returns details of all the exhibitor booths pertaining to the event.

This API also features media downloads. To get the media URLs, use the key isSendMedia with value true to get all the applicable media in response.

Response Body

Keys Type Description
hubiloExhibitorId Integer Hubilo exhibitor ID
clientExhibitorId String Exhibitor ID given by client
name String Booth name
email String Booth email address
phone String Booth contact number
logo String Booth logo
description String Short description of booth
website String Booth's website URL
address String Booth address
facebook String Booth's Facebook handle URL
linkedin String Booth's LinkedIn handle URL
twitter String Booth's Twitter handle URL
instagram String Booth's Instagram handle URL
profileImg String Exhibitor’s profile photo
spotlightBannerType String Banner type: Image/Video
spotlightBanner Array This is a large banner placed at the top of the exhibitor’s profile
brochure String First file from the 'multipleFile'
multipleFile Array Exhibitor booth's files, max limit: 10 Files
listBannerImage String This banner is displayed at the booth card on the exhibitor's list
smallBannerImage String This banner is displayed at the booth card on the reception and sessions page
boothSize String Booth Size (Large-Medium-Small)

request.description:
This API allows you to delist one or more exhibitor booths at a time. This is an irreversible action.

  1. In order to use the API, eventId and either hubiloExhibitorId or clientExhibitorId are required. Exhibitor IDs can be retrieved via Exhibitor Booths API.

  2. A maximum of 100 exhibitor booths can be delisted at once.

  3. Delisting a booth will remove them from organiser dashboard and the published event.

  4. This API maps to the 'Delete Virtual Booth' functionality in organizer dashboard.

Note: This is an asynchronous API and may take upto a maximum of 10 minutes for the action to be complete. If any ID is incorrect or not found in our database, it will get ignored and only the valid ones will get delisted. To verify, you can use the Exhibitor Booths API - delisted booths will not be returned in the response.

Response Body

Keys Type Description
data String Status Message

request.description:
You can use this API to unlink booth member from booth via email. This is an irreversible action.

  1. In order to use the API, eventId and email are required.
  2. If the booth member is removed, then it will be unlinked from booth as teammember and will have user group assigned as attendee.
  3. A maximum of 100 booth members can be removed at once.

Note: This is an asynchronous API and may take upto a maximum of 10 minutes for the action to be complete. If any ID is incorrect or not found in our database, it will get ignored and only the valid ones will get removed.

Response Body

Keys Type Description
data String Status Message

request.description:
This API allows adding a new team member (user as an exhibitor/booth-member or user as an attendee) and their details to an existing event.

If hubiloExhibitorId is passed with the right value in the request body, the user gets created as an exhibitor. This ID can be retrieved by calling the GET Exhibitor Booths API or via Dashboard.

Please note that if a user is being created as an exhibitor, then memberGroupId needs to be passed with Booth Member group ID.
If memberGroupId is passed with the attendee ID in the request body, the user gets created as an attendee. ​This ID can be retrieved by calling the GET Member Group Type API or via Dashboard.

Go to the Dashboard, select the desired event, go to the Virtual Booth tab from the left menu and click to select the desired booth. The URL after /virtual-detail/ is the hubiloExhibitorId. To retrieve the memberGroupId, select the event, go to settings, select Groups and you will be able to see respective groups and the IDs.

You may also need to get a custom field structure that can be retrieved from GET Custom Fields of Users for an Event.

Response Body

Keys Type Description
data String Status Message

Custom field table

Custom Field Type Data Type Example
Text String "text"
Text Area String "text area"
Date String "31-05-2022" or "31/05/2022"
Dropdown String "dropdown1"
Checkbox Array ["checkbox1", "checkbox2"]
Radio String "radio1"
Link String "link"
Group Array of object [{"1": "group1"}, {"1": "group2"}]

Note: Please use respective custom field ID from the Dashboard.
Go to Events -> Settings -> Profile Fields -> Select Field and inspect element, then copy all IDs from the network tab for user groups.

request.description:
The details of a previously created user as an exhibitor team member or as an attendee can be edited via this API. hubiloExhibitorId can be retrieved by calling the GET Exhibitor Booths API or via Dashboard.

Go to the Dashboard, select the desired event, go to the Virtual Booth tab from the left menu and click to select the desired booth.

The URL after /virtual-detail/ is the desired ID. You may also need to get a custom field structure that can be retrieved from GET Custom Fields of Users for an Event for an Event.

Please see the applicable cases below based on the value of the key:isReplaceMemberGroupId.

If isReplaceMemberGroupId == true, then the following details will be updated (replaced):

  1. None of the memberGroupId can be updated as a speaker.
  2. Speaker group can be replaced as an attendee, booth member and/or any custom group.
  3. While replacing booth member with attendee/custom group, hubiloExhibitorId should not be passed in the request body.
  4. Booth member can be updated within an event by sending required hubiloExhibitorId.
  5. Attendee can be replaced as booth member and/or other custom groups.
  6. Booth member can be replaced as Attendee and/or other custom groups.
  7. Custom group can be replaced as attendee, booth member and/or other custom groups.

If isReplaceMemberGroupId == false, then the following details will be appended:

  1. If the user is Attendee, only the profile details can be updated. An attendee cannot be appended to the speaker group or as a booth member.
  2. A booth member can be appended as an attendee, but not as a speaker.
  3. A speaker can be appended as an attendee but not as a booth member.
  4. Member group ID always gets appended to the user group when a successful update happens.
  5. Any updates made using this API will reflect on all the events irrespective of the event ID used. This is because the user profile fields are global. However, registrations are always at event level.

Note: Any updates made using this API will update the data across all events since we store the user details at the organizer level. However, registrations are always at an event level.

Response Body

Keys Type Description
data String Status Message

item.description:
These APIs will allow the user to automate media uploads. To see the Hubilo event sections that support this functionality, please refer to the 'Media Upload Type' table present in this API below.

There are 3 steps (API Calls) to complete a media upload and are defined below. You will find the detailed explanation about the API usage in the respective API section.

Step 1. Get Pre-Signed URLs : The first step is to call this API which will return a unique URL uploadURL along with other metadata.
Step 2. Use the URL received in Step 1 to upload the actual media from your local server/system.
Step 3. Call Upload Media Acknowledgement API after uploading media file in Step 2 to send an acknowledgement to the server stating that the media has been uploaded.

Please find below suggestive measures to build an automation for uploading media:

1. All the three steps will need to be sequentially successful in order to complete the media upload.
2. Our servers support building multiple pre-signed URLs and you can call the Get Pre Signed URL API multiple times in order to achieve that. We recommend to set a maximum rate limit of 5 requests/second for media upload APIs.
3. Please maintain a log of all the API requests sent for debugging in case of any errors/issues.
4. We recommend you to store status in any database/cache system against all the requests sent in Step 1, 2 and 3.
5. Furthermore, you can mark the status of these requests as a successful upload once you receive HTTP response code as 200 OK in Step 2.
6. For all the statuses marked as successful uploads, you can then call the ack API mentioned in Step 3 and upon successful response, update the status of such requests as complete.
7. Please note that each pre-signed URL is valid to be used once. Uploads may fail if the same pre-signed URL is used more than once.

Note: If media is not uploaded in the suggested dimensions, file type, & size, then the API response may be successful, but the media may appear distorted or not show up on the dashboard. It is strictly advised to do a thorough data sanity as per the table in following APIs.
